messages:
sam: Heads-up — ACME-prod complaining about sudden p99 spike for eu-west requests (~700–900ms). They say traces show traffic hitting us-east before returning. No auth errors, but some 504s. @maria @nina can you triage? Trace id: trace-7b9f

maria: looking. any repro steps we can run?

sam: Steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/generate region eu-west1 2) include X-Customer-ID 3) repeat. Attached quick curl they ran:
```bash
for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "X-Customer-ID: acme" -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'; done
```
They also pasted traceroute:
```text
traceroute to api.redwood.prod (34.85.12.3), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1 (10.0.0.1)  1.123 ms
 2  172.16.0.1 (172.16.0.1)  2.234 ms
 6  34.85.12.3 (34.85.12.3)  781.456 ms  <- routed via us-east-peer
```

nina: That looks like egress peering to us-east. Can you paste the redwood trace output? Use `redwood trace dump --id trace-7b9f`

sam: pasted below:
```json
{ "trace_id":"trace-7b9f", "spans":[ {"span":"client->edge","region":"eu-west-1","lat_ms":45}, {"span":"edge->egress","region":"us-east-1","lat_ms":720}, {"span":"egress->model","region":"us-east-1","lat_ms":30} ] }
```

maria: I see edge is in eu-west but egress routed to us-east. Likely route-policy fallback for this customer hit and selected cheaper egress. @ops-oncall can we temporarily pin this tenant to eu-west (route override) while net investigates?

ops-oncall: can do. Command:
```bash
redwood routes override --tenant acme --region eu-west-1 --expires 1h
```
Applying now.

deploy-bot: canary deploy redwood-egress-policy v2 started at 2024-09-18T09:10:00Z (id: canary-224)

nina: that canary aligns with spike time. Probably regression in policy evaluation causing incorrect region preference. I'll pull the policy diff.

maria: after override pinging ACME traces, p99 dropped to ~115ms. Need follow-up: rollback canary or fix policy rule.

sam: customer reported improved latency and no more 504s. Thanks team :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: keeping override for 1h then removing; will open ticket ENGNET-453.

maria: Opening PR to add stricter region affinity checks, tagging eng-network. cc @nina

sam: closing on support side once ENGNET-453 lands.
